valid:
run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj u : User |
    some disj p : Photo |
    some disj d : Day {
        User = u
        Influencer = none
        Photo = p
        Ad = p
        Day = d
        User <: follows = none->none
        User <: sees = none->none
        User <: posts = u->p
        User <: suggested = none->none
        Photo <: date = p->d
    }
} for exactly 1 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

run PositiveScenario3 {
    some disj w : Workstation |
    some disj r : Worker |
    some disj c1, c2 : Product {
        Workstation = w
        begin = w
        end = w
        Worker = r
        Human = none
        Robot = r
        Product = c1 + c2
        Material = none
        Component = c1 + c2
        Dangerous = none
        Workstation <: workers = w->r
        Workstation <: succ = none->none
        Product <: parts = c1->c2 + c2->c1
        Component <: workstation = c1->w + c2->w
    }
} for exactly 1 Workstation, exactly 1 Worker, exactly 2 Product expect 1
